title: Put R5,000 in an RA, get R1,300 back #RetirementAnnuity
text:
Money you put into a retirement fund can be deducted from your taxable income, up to 27.5% of your income and up to R430,000 a year (from 1 March 2026). Sipho's bonus put him in the 26% step, so every rand he puts into a retirement annuity this tax year saves him 26 cents in tax: R5,000 in, about R1,300 back from SARS when he files his return. A retirement annuity is for retirement: most of the money stays locked in until you retire.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
